verdict.rationale: A single community hands-on benchmark shows Ollama loading and running the same model in q4_K_M, nvfp4 and int4 quantizations via 'ollama run', so it does handle some 4-bit formats. There is no first-party documentation of supported quantization formats in the pack. missing for 10: first-party docs on supported quantization formats, evidence of FP8 support, evidence of GPTQ support, evidence of AWQ support, guidance on how to import or load quantized weights.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ

citations.quote: qwen3.5:35b-a3b-q4_K_M eval rate 30.0, nvfp4 66.5, int4 84.4 tokens/sec via 'ollama run' with --verbose
